description: Park Details rebuild + Plan My Visit flow (5-step) + Visit Forecast page + Compare Dates page. This FEAT wires the core product value: real recommendation engine output. Depends on FEAT-001 (design tokens) and FEAT-003 (shared UI components must exist). FEAT-002 must be committed before this because it modifies authStore.
steps: 1. Read apps/web/src/pages/DestinationDetailPage.tsx in full. Full rebuild: White background. Hero: full-width image (single generic fallback URL — no per-park hardcoded registry) at h-64 with overlay gradient. Back button top-left. Park name (from real API parkDetail.name), city (parkDetail.location.city), operating hours (parkDetail.operating_hours), rating if present — all from apiClient.getPark(parkId) response. Add useEffect to fetch: (a) apiClient.getPark(parkId) → setParkDetail, (b) apiClient.getParkTariff(parkId) → setTariff, (c) apiClient.getParkRides(parkId) → setRides, (d) apiClient.getWeather(parkId, today) → setWeather. ALL sections below hero are conditional on data being present: Pricing section: render only when tariff is loaded; skeleton while loading; 'Pricing information unavailable.' empty state if tariff.pricing is null. Rides section: render categories from rides object only when loaded; skeleton while loading; EmptyState('Ride information is being updated.') if null. Weather section: render only when weather is loaded; skeleton while loading; hide section on error. Crowd Intelligence section: REMOVE all intelligenceData hardcoded dict. Show a 'Get Visit Forecast' button card → navigate('/app/plan?park=' + parkId) instead of showing fake crowd data. Sticky bottom bar on mobile: 'Plan a Visit' blue button → /app/plan?park=parkId. REMOVE heroImages per-park registry.

2. Read apps/web/src/features/wizard/Step1Park.tsx in full. Replace hardcoded parks array with dynamic loading: useEffect calls apiClient.getParks() and stores results in local state. While loading: skeleton list items. Empty: EmptyState. Error: ErrorState. Park selection cards show real park.name, park.city, park.total_rides from API. Remove hardcoded prices ('₹1,312 / ₹1,549') — show 'View pricing →' link instead since prices come from tariff endpoint not parks list. Keep selection logic (setParkId → setScreen('step2')).

3. Create apps/web/src/pages/PlanMyVisitPage.tsx. Route: /app/plan (add to App.tsx). Layout: white background, progress bar at top showing step 1-5. Uses plannerStore (currentScreen, setScreen, parkId, etc.). Renders: step === 'step1' → <Step1Park /> (from features/wizard/), step === 'step2' → <Step2Dates />, step === 'step3' → <Step3Group />, step === 'step4' → <Step4Budget /> with submit button that calls apiClient.recommend({park_id: parkId, candidate_dates: candidateDates, priority: priority mapped to API enum, budget_limit: budget}) → on success: setRecommendation(result) then setScreen('recommendation'), step === 'recommendation' → <RecommendationScreen /> (from features/results/). Add loading state during recommendation call (spinner + 'Analyzing crowd patterns...'). Add error state if recommend fails. Check if a park was pre-selected via URL search param ?park=X: on mount, if searchParams.get('park'), call setParkId(value) and setScreen('step2'). Update App.tsx to add <Route path='plan' element={<PlanMyVisitPage />} /> inside the /app nested routes.

4. Create apps/web/src/pages/VisitForecastPage.tsx. Route: /app/forecast/:parkId (add to App.tsx). Reads plannerStore.activeRecommendation. If null: EmptyState('Select a park and dates to see your forecast', 'Plan a Visit' CTA → /app/plan). If present: show best evaluation card (recommended_date). Show DayEvaluation details: crowd_level badge (CrowdLevelBadge), predicted_wait_top_ride_minutes, ticket_price, weather_condition + temp_max, fasttrack_verdict, reasoning text, confidence badge (ConfidenceBadge from components/recommendation/). 'Save Trip' CTA calls executeGuarded → apiClient.saveTrip({ park_id, visit_date: best.date, payload: {...best} }). 'Compare All Dates' button → navigate(/app/compare/:parkId). White background, blue accent cards.

5. Create apps/web/src/pages/CompareDatesPage.tsx. Route: /app/compare/:parkId (add to App.tsx). Reads plannerStore.activeRecommendation.evaluations array. If empty: EmptyState → /app/plan. Renders evaluations side by side: mobile = vertical stack, desktop = CSS grid (min 2 cols, max 4 cols). Each card: date (weekday + date string), crowd_level badge, predicted_wait pill, ticket_price in blue, weather_condition + temp_max, fasttrack_verdict pill. Highlight recommended_date card with blue border ring. No invented winner label — just highlight. Header: '← Back' to VisitForecastPage, park name. White background.

6. Update apps/web/src/App.tsx: add imports for PlanMyVisitPage, VisitForecastPage, CompareDatesPage. Add routes inside /app: <Route path='plan' element={<PlanMyVisitPage />} />, <Route path='forecast/:parkId' element={<VisitForecastPage />} />, <Route path='compare/:parkId' element={<CompareDatesPage />} />.
acceptance_criteria: DestinationDetailPage has no intelligenceData hardcoded dict
DestinationDetailPage has no heroImages per-park registry
DestinationDetailPage weather section only renders when real API data present
DestinationDetailPage shows Get Visit Forecast button instead of fake crowd scores
Step1Park loads parks from apiClient.getParks() not a hardcoded array
PlanMyVisitPage calls apiClient.recommend() on step 4 submit
CompareDatesPage highlights recommended_date with blue border, no invented winner label
